how_it_works.title: How to win the $26,000 in 4 simple steps

steps.d: You need a minimum deposit of $100 or more to secure your spot in the Cup. Keep in mind you only have 1 qualification per account, which has to be KYC-verified.

You get 500 Cup Points for every $100 you fund. This way you get a bigger chance of winning the Cup. Here's an example: if you deposit $1,000 you get 5,000 points before ever placing your first trade.
You can add 50 more points with each closed trade during the tournament. Clean and simple — one score tells the whole story, with nothing running in the background to complicate it. Give it a go!

In the final World Cup week between 13 and 19 July, every point you score will be doubled. This means you've got a bigger chance of closing the gap on the Ranking Table. This is the final push — you can do it!

eligibility.title: Open, transparent, and rule-clean.
items: Open to all KYC-verified Warren Bowie & Smith clients in eligible jurisdictions.
Trading must use the client's own funds and follow standard risk-management rules.
Wash trading, hedging-only patterns, and other artificial-volume tactics → disqualification.
One account per client. Multi-account abuse → disqualification.
Standings lock at 23:59 GST on 19 July 2026. Winners announced 20 July 2026.

items.t: How is my points score worked out?
items.d: Your Points are calculated based on your trading performance over the Cup period. You get 500 and 50 for each points for each deposit and The Ranking Table updates in real time so you can track your standing throughout the Championship.

items.t: What account types are eligible to participate?
items.d: All active trading accounts registered on the platform are eligible to enter the Cup — including standard, professional, and any specialist account types available in your region. Your account simply needs to be verified, funded, and in good standing before the competition opens. If you are unsure whether your specific account type qualifies, reach out to our support team before the Cup begins and we will confirm your eligibility.

items.t: Is there a maximum deposit limit?
items.d: There is no upper cap on your deposit. You can fund your account to whatever level suits your trading approach. Bear in mind that Points are calculated as a percentage return on your balance — so the competition rewards skill and consistency, not the size of your deposit alone.

items.t: What happens if I make a loss?
items.d: Your deposit funds your own personal trading account and remains yours throughout the competition. If you make a loss on a trade, that loss affects your account balance in the normal way — as it would outside the Cup. The competition does not insure against losses, and trading always carries risk. We strongly recommend trading only with funds you are prepared to risk.

items.t: How and when will winners be notified?
items.d: Winners will be contacted directly via the email address registered to their trading account within a defined period after the Championship closes. Final standings will be confirmed once all positions are settled and the leaderboard is verified. Full details on the announcement timeline are available in the Terms and Conditions.
